purpose: Search alternate photo-page sources for under-covered taxa after exact iNaturalist searches produced no new leads.
source_scope: Exact species-level iNaturalist observations plus Wikimedia Commons file pages matched by species-name text; preserve source type, search-match warning, attribution, and licence claims.
copy_policy: Archive only photo-level CC0 or CC BY iNaturalist candidate files; keep Wikimedia Commons pages, all other rights, and unknown rights as source links for owner review.
